dublin_core_group.title: Huayhuash DEM 10m (Copernicus)
dublin_core_group.description: A raster dataset with yearly averages of the 2m temperature from the ERA 5 renanalysis data from Copernicus satellite sensors for Tanzania. ERA5 is the fifth generation ECMWF reanalysis for the global climate and weather for the past 8 decades. Data is available from 1940 onwards. ERA5 replaces the ERA-Interim reanalysis.

iso_group.process_step:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/hh_dem_copernicus/download -p /data/hh_dem_copernicus/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/hh_dem_copernicus
cd /data/hh_dem_copernicus

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# clone a git repo and run the code# save netcdf as tif
cd download
gdal_translate NETCDF:hh_dem_copernicus.nc:2m_temperature hh_dem_copernicus.tif
cd ..


#########
# Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
####

# load raster into postGIS with:
    raster2pgsql -s 4326 -d -C -I -t auto hh_dem_copernicus.tif -F hh_dem_copernicus > load_raster.sql
psql <connection options> < load_raster.sql
rm load_raster.sql

# Move into corrrect directory and create derivative directory in data package on osgeo
cd /data/hh_dem_copernicus/
mkdir -p derived

# Create downloadable zip of download/geotiff in derivate directory 
rm -f derived/hh_dem_copernicus.tif.tar.gz
tar -czf derived/hh_dem_copernicus.tif.tar.gz meta_dcat_hh_dem_copernicus.json -C download hh_dem_copernicus.tif

# Move into correct directory
cd /data/hh_dem_copernicus/
